description: Defines enums, a struct, and functions related to PHR configuration parameters such as timers and power factors in the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: phr_config
classes.description: Structure representing PHR configuration parameters including timers, power factors, and modes.

methods.name: phr_periodic_timer_to_value
methods.description: Converts phr_periodic_timer enum to its underlying integer value.

methods.name: phr_prohibit_timer_to_value
methods.description: Converts phr_prohibit_timer enum to its underlying integer value.

methods.name: to_phr_prohibit_timer
methods.description: Converts an unsigned integer to the corresponding phr_prohibit_timer enum value, with error handling.

methods.name: phr_tx_pw_factor_change_to_value
methods.description: Converts phr_tx_power_factor_change enum to its underlying integer value.
